correctness.rationale: Exact finite graph on 28 Fano-noncollinear triples and 42 edges. Enumerated all 84 matchings via exhaustive least-free-vertex recursion. Python tests all 2^14 subsets of every matching against the necessary-and-sufficient difference-mask forcing criterion; separate C++ residual extension DP agrees on all polynomial coefficients. Backtracking enumerates all 336 automorphisms independently of the 336 explicit geometric symmetries and shows transitivity; 51 minimum-quartet orbit reps exhaust 16632 sets. Symmetric differences enumerate all 74 alternating cycles; all 10-cycles meet the unique 8-cycle, ruling out triple disjoint cycles, while a disjoint pair is exhibited. All statements are finite, and full standalone source/certificates are embedded.

value.rationale: Matching forcing is a natural identification problem. On a classical symmetric 28-vertex nonhamiltonian cubic graph, all 84 matchings share a nontrivial 11-term local forcing-subset polynomial; the classification of 16632 optimal quartets into 51 group orbits resolves more than an aggregate size. The strict 4-versus-2 transversal/packing gap provides a meaningful explicit boundary case beyond planar bipartite minimax and has mathematical value independent of its small order. No unsupported asymptotic or new-forcing-number-definition claim is made.
